response.sql: WITH rental_by_rating AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(r.rental_id) as rental_count FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(rental_count) as avg_rentals FROM rental_by_rating), above_average_ratings AS (SELECT rbr.rental_count, oa.avg_rentals, rbr.rental_count - oa.avg_rentals as above_overall FROM rental_by_rating rbr CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE rbr.rental_count > oa.avg_rentals) SELECT AVG(rental_count) as avg_for_above_average_ratings, AVG(above_overall) as avg_distance_above_overall FROM above_average_ratings;

assumptions.assumption: Rentals are counted by rental_id (each rental transaction is one unit), including unreturned rentals.
